thread:
Maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need a small, targeted eval expansion to catch the KV-cache invalidation pattern. Proposal below.
Sam: sounds good. keep it lightweight so CI doesn't blow up.
Maya: minimal plan: add a named prompt_set + a short perf smoke + a nightly deterministic regression run. Also a one-off chaos fuzz run in staging.
Diego: can you paste the test contract you want added?
Maya: heres the minimal YAML snippet I put in the doc: 
```
# evals/config snippet
prompt_set: kv_cache_guard
cases:
  - name: prefix_reuse
    gen_modes: [deterministic, sampling]
  - name: alternating_roles
    gen_modes: [deterministic]
  - name: truncated_kv_tail
metrics: [p95_latency, token_consistency_rate, failure_rate]
run_targets:
  - nightly: deterministic_subset
  - staging: fuzz_worker(30m)
```
Sam: good. call out that sampling-only failures were observed, so include temp=0.8 in sampling cases.
Diego: agree. impl note: include multi-turn header and alternating system/user markers; bug reproduced with role alternation.
Maya: owners I'm proposing: Diego = prompt_set + harness (1 sprint); Sam = CI job + dashboard integration (2w); Infra = small staging pool + guard rails (3w).
Rachel: can we add an explicit postmortem step: "add test + owner to PM checklist"? Otherwise follow-ups get lost.
Maya: yes, adding that now.
eval-ci-bot: Reminder: nightly retriggers require approval for new job definitions. See CI-OPS-510.
Sam: I'll file the CI approval and add Prometheus alert rules: token_consistency delta > 0.4% OR p95 > baseline*1.2 triggers pager to #incidents (notify on-call).
Diego: for chaos fuzz in staging: run randomized prefix lengths and interleaved API burst at 50% of production QPS to avoid impacting other tests.
infra-bot: Note: request for dedicated staging pool recorded in ENGOPS-2803. Pool creation ETA ~4 business days.
Maya: timeline sanity check: prompts + harness in 1 sprint -> CI wiring + infra -> nightly runs within 3 weeks. If anything slips, escalate to PM owners listed in the postmortem.
Sam: I'll add action items to the retro doc and tag owners with dates.
Diego: will open PR for prompt_set template today and include deterministic seeds + sampling seeds.
Rachel: can we ensure the console surfaces regression results as an eval alert row? Ops tends to miss buried CI results.
Sam: yes, dashboard row + slack integration planned. eval-ci-bot will post summary when nightly completes.
Maya: thanks. marking this high priority for the sprint and adding to the postmortem follow-up list. @here :mag:
Rachel: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turn.
